algolia.name: Bower - Memory Card Wallet
algolia.description: Keep your memory cards safe with the Bower SAMW20 memory card wallet that features water-resistant leatherette material. Compact in size, this wallet case is great for on-the-go carrying and secures up to 20 of your memory cards.
